meta.title: Codex subagent (bundled CLI)
meta.description: MIT fork of the Codex subagent provider that runs the pinned bundled @openai/codex 0.169.0 binary (codexPath and PATH overrides) with the existing ~/.codex login, model/reasoning-effort targets, read-only and workspace-write providers, codex_subagent_status, and the visible codex_subagent tool
